name: @treaty/schematics
description: Zero-config Angular schematics for Treaty. `ng add @treaty/schematics` rewrites angular.json to the @treaty/build builders and scaffolds the Module Federation structure (host + a sample remote, shared Angular singletons) automatically; the `application` and `library` generators keep that federation structure out-of-the-box (a remote app is exposable, a host consumes remotes) with zero MF config. Treaty is a compiler, not a host: the developer configures nothing.
author: Jordan Hall
